purpose: Replace PB32Round conditional increment with its exact integer carry predicate, only in the existing ordinary portable normal Endpoint module. Other arithmetic, all native/owner/Transport modules, capabilities, modes, program tables, scratch, buffers, layouts and execution/stream semantics remain untouched.
proof: Let r=extended&7 and p=(extended>>3)&1. For p=0, the original condition is r>4. For p=1 it is r>=4, equivalently r>3. Thus the original condition equals r>4-p in both exhaustive parity classes. uint(bool) is0 or1. The same pre-increment sig=extended>>3 receives exactly the same increment. r and p stay in[0,7] and[0,1], so threshold is3 or4 and no subtraction underflows. sig<=0x1fffffff before increment for every uint32 extended, so the addition cannot overflow. Underflow jam, carry normalization, overflow, signed zero and packing are byte-exact surrounding source.
